key.name: directory-template
key.description:
All directories will be created within the top-level session directory according to the specified template. You can use variables for substituting context-specific values.
Available variables: {sample}, {group}, {container}, {position}, {port}, {date}, {activity}.

key.name: dataset-naming
key.description:
Determines how datasets will be named within data runs. With "Manual" dataset names are specified manually within runs. "Auto" names datasets according to the sample name with an automated suffix appended. It is recommended to use the "Auto" method when using the Automounter with sample information from MxLIVE. "Auto" reverts to "Manual" when no sample is mounted.
Allowed: 'Manual', 'Auto'.

key.name: screening-method
key.description:
Analysis method for screening images. The default is 'AutoProcess'.
Allowed: 'AutoProcess', 'MOSFLM'.

key.name: auto-structure-solution
key.description: Run Automated Structure Solution pipeline after data processing.
